dogecoin.text: $SHIB, $DOGE, $RVN, $ETH, $BTC, $XMR, $CRO, $ALGO, and $XYO are the tokens in my portfolio. What do you #HODL?
@AaronDayAtlas I've been telling people for the last several months $DOGE is insanely overvalued. (No hate, I've mined it in the past and I #HODL it.) Hopefully they've listened.

@AshleyDCan If I had a magic 10k just show up it'd go into GPUs and an ASIC. Passive income > Speculation. If I had to just buy coins, I'd probably go a combination of $ETH and $RVN. Different ecosystems and both have huge potential upsides. I mined enough $DOGE to ride the 🚀 if it goes.

@CadillacRvn I think $DOGE is an important crypto due to its mass adoption. and the interest it has brought to crypto. It's also still massively overvalued, but it's important. I can't hate on exchanges for trading it, even though I sort of feel like they're trying to trade tulips.
